findings.statement: D-027, D-028, and D-029 are genuine and distinct scientific or numerical-method failures, not artifacts of harness fragility or later review strictness. D-027's non-adjoint pointwise action missed frozen S1 conservation/exchange caps; D-028's conservative Galerkin method missed the prospectively frozen native mu-tau cap; D-029's executable selector/prior/exact-node rule was not the continuous fixed-triple method that had been derived. Each was stopped before trajectory authority.
assumptions_used: The frozen caps and method definitions were prospective and were not relaxed after output.
The preserved adjudications and exact failed artifacts are authoritative within their bounded static scopes.
counterevidence_refs: D-027 common-FD null passed; D-028 passed every recorded gate except native covariance; D-029's fixed-triple theorem and local binary64 stencil passed within narrow limits.
findings.first_introduced: Bounded: each candidate was introduced between its predecessor decision and its 2026-07-18 registered run; no immutable commit identifies the dirty-tree candidate byte introduction.
findings.first_detectable: D-027 and D-028 were first detectable by their prospectively frozen M1 discriminators in the same runs; D-029 was detectable by comparing its two sealed design artifacts before implementation.
findings.why_earlier_checks_missed_it: Common-FD nulls, local stencil identities, and modal conservation are weaker than resolved non-null conservation, native covariance, selector continuity, and collision-level contracts.
findings.strongest_counterargument: The methods were mostly coherent and failed only because the programme used unusually strict caps.
findings.falsifier: Recompute the preserved metrics under the unchanged prospective definitions; a value within cap or one coherent selector derivation would weaken this classification.
findings.attempted_break_test: Compared partial passes with the exact binding failures and verified that the failure conditions were not added after output.
reproduction: Read the three preserved adjudications and exact artifact hashes; no numerical rerun is authorized or needed for this historical classification.
unresolved: The broader viability of a different conservative method remains unresolved; these failures do not prove that every B3-like method must fail.
findings.recommendation: Retain all three as immutable discriminators and require any new method to beat the same prospective static gates before implementation.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not relax caps, project or symmetrize output, retry reductions, run GL64, or reinterpret bounded subclaim passes as method validation.

findings.statement: The Fort sequence mixed separable failure classes. The initial contract was not executable; r2 failed cache closure; r3 failed executable-byte and failure-retention authority; r4 finally exposed a real stock-source exact-lower-node interpolation defect; r5 then failed because its blind assignment omitted the controller and file-level baseline needed to authorize physical output. Harness and bundle defects delayed evidence, while the lower-node source defect was the scientific proximate cause of the GL60 anomaly. No Fort endpoint was validated.
assumptions_used: FortEPiaNO 1.4.0 commit 6cac851 is the pinned upstream source authority.
Initial-only, one-RHS, zero-DLSODA evidence cannot be promoted to endpoint evidence.
counterevidence_refs: Every stage failed closed and materially localized the next defect; r4 exact tuple-set correlation is strong bounded evidence, and r6 later validated patch causality only.
findings.first_introduced: Contract omissions existed no later than the first 2026-07-17 independent-v2 freeze; cache and authority defects were introduced in their respective run-local bundles. The interpolation defect existed no later than pinned upstream commit 6cac851; its earlier origin is unresolved.
findings.first_detectable: Contract/cache/authority defects were detectable pre-output or at startup. The interpolation defect was in principle detectable by an exact-native-node unit oracle before physical output, but was actually localized after r4's 2026-07-18 GL60 anomaly.
findings.why_earlier_checks_missed_it: Canonical upstream tests did not exercise the comparison's strict constants/layout/metrics or exact lower-node interpolation semantics; bundle reviews closed one authority layer at a time.
findings.strongest_counterargument: The staged sequence was rational fail-closed engineering, not process failure.
findings.falsifier: A single prospective end-to-end nonphysical suite covering full cache closure, loader bytes, controller scope, and exact native endpoints would have passed the earlier bundles.
findings.attempted_break_test: Separated r3's explicitly non-scientific authority failure from r4's source-correlated raw-action anomaly and r5's assignment-context failure.
reproduction: Inspect the preserved adjudication chain and r4's exact affected-index equality; do not rerun immutable bundles.
unresolved: The exact historical commit that first introduced Fort's strict-lower-bracket behavior was not reconstructed.
No Fort endpoint evidence exists, so endpoint-level agreement remains unresolved.
findings.recommendation: Keep Fort r6 contextual and stopped. If history is revisited, use the preserved exact-node failure as a test-oracle lesson, not as authority to reopen whole-program Fort.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not attribute all Fort failures to physics, treat authority closure as endpoint progress, or add another wrapper/cache/telemetry loop.

findings.statement: The recurrent B3-v2/W7 failure is executable-contract debt plus an inadequate test oracle. The initial W6 entered Git as a 178-line design-only proof pack at 229847d. The current W6 is 621 lines and the sealed unexecuted W7 source is 2,198 lines, yet source-only checks proved only record counts, branch examples, ladder cardinality, and object equality. D-037 then found concrete self-inconsistencies: per-leg shell requirements were aggregated or skipped at threshold, proof-mandated coefficient-Horner evaluation was bypassed by cached node values, directed tail enclosures had no executable rigorous integrator, and A0-A4/event traces admitted incomplete caller-supplied graphs.
assumptions_used: The W6 prose requirements are binding design obligations rather than optional future implementation notes.
A design claiming a reconstructible metrology bound must make nonconforming caller behavior impossible or detectable.
counterevidence_refs: D-037 independently passed reaction nullspace, entropy affinity, direct row-ii normalization, and absolute normalization subclaims; the 20-row selection closure also exists.
findings.first_introduced: Initial architectural under-specification is present at 229847d on 2026-07-22. The exact current defects were introduced in an uncommitted interval after D-034's 2026-07-22 FAIL and before D-035 sealing on 2026-07-23.
findings.first_detectable: The initial W6 defects were detectable in the external branch review and D-033. The current shell/basis/tail/trace defects were detectable immediately from the sealed source and proof and were detected by D-037 before execution.
findings.why_earlier_checks_missed_it: Draft checks asserted existence and equality of selected objects, not semantic closure, negative controls, per-consumer basis provenance, tail enclosure rigor, or exact trace cardinality.
findings.strongest_counterargument: Auditors are demanding unnecessary formalism from a design that would probably work numerically.
findings.falsifier: A clause-to-symbol closure matrix plus adversarial source checks should show every binding obligation is enforced and reject incomplete traces, unequal-scale shell rescue, node-value consumers, and scalar-only tails. The current bytes do not meet that test.
findings.attempted_break_test: Compared each D-037 failure against the proof pack's own binding language and retained all four genuine pass subclaims rather than treating the whole design as uniformly wrong.
reproduction: Use the D-037 line-referenced static reproductions; no W7 or B3 execution is required.
unresolved: Whether B3-v2 remains the best architecture after a clean redesign is unresolved.
No numerical evidence exists for W7 or B3 on the current bytes.
findings.recommendation: Do not authorize another literal patch yet. First require an owner decision on whether to continue and, if continued, a bounded obligation-to-enforcement matrix with negative controls and an explicit deletion/consolidation budget.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not execute W7/B3, infer sufficiency from record counts or source/vector equality, or convert bounded algebraic passes into whole-design authority.

findings.statement: Harness defects were root causes of untrustworthy admission and write attribution, but not of the scientific failures. D-031 assumed a PreToolUse event that VS Code collaboration does not emit and an early retry path could bypass Stop validation; D-034's structural validator passed while Sage/Singular created undeclared repository-root .singularhistory; D-035 then lost admissible results through runtime-role misregistration and uppercase verdict enums. D-036's schema-v2 runtime/review-role separation, sealed role/template hashes, retry-safe Stop, temporary cwd, and parent pre/post hashes repaired the supported boundary. D-037 still failed scientifically after that repair.
assumptions_used: Live event evidence outranks static hook fixtures for event availability and external-tool containment.
The unchanged D-037 parent hashes establish result-only writes only within the declared parent/Start/Stop boundary.
counterevidence_refs: D-032 R4 and D-036 R3 demonstrate that the supported workaround can be enforced live; D-037 preserved identical pre/post hashes.
findings.first_introduced: D-031 event assumptions and retry semantics were introduced before the 2026-07-22 R2/R3 probes; D-034's external-tool cwd defect existed in its assignment/run; D-035 identity defects existed in its v1 registrations.
findings.first_detectable: Only live canaries exposed the PreToolUse and retry gaps. Repository status hashing exposed .singularhistory. Live Stop exposed runtime/role and enum mismatches.
findings.why_earlier_checks_missed_it: validate_harness validates registered JSON contracts and result paths but cannot prove a VS Code event fired or that an external process wrote nowhere else in the repository.
findings.strongest_counterargument: Harness failures contaminated reviewer conclusions and therefore explain the scientific FAILs.
findings.falsifier: If the same exact source findings disappeared after D-036 under valid schema-v2 reviewers, the harness-causation hypothesis would gain support. D-037 instead reproduced binding source defects.
findings.attempted_break_test: Compared pre-repair false admissions and unauthorized writes with the post-repair D-037 exact-byte findings and kept process PASS separate from science FAIL.
reproduction: Read current Start/Stop hooks and the D-034 through D-037 validation-ledger rows; verify .singularhistory SHA-256 5abbc842.
unresolved: VS Code collaboration PreToolUse remains unavailable and must not be claimed.
Exclusive write attribution still depends on main-owned pre/post hashing, not Stop alone.
findings.recommendation: Freeze the supported schema-v2 parent/Start/Stop contract and require external-tool cwd confinement plus parent-side whole-tree attribution for every future run.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not claim launch interception, infer science from harness PASS, or hide/rewrite rejected results and unauthorized artifacts.

findings.statement: The 2026-07-19 public-history reroot is not supported as a scientific cause, but it weakens commit-level first-introduction tracing. The exact legacy Git database, 37-ref bundle, and quarantined runs were preserved. W3 and W5 on the blocker and successor branches have byte-identical blobs despite new commit IDs, and D-037 fails on current exact hashes. However, the active branch stops at 00a15d3 while W6, W7, ledgers, hooks, and later D-033 through D-037 state are dirty or untracked, so those changes can be dated only by sealed run intervals rather than immutable commits.
assumptions_used: Exact blob equality is sufficient to identify rerooted W3/W5 content despite commit-ID changes.
Preserved run hashes are valid interval evidence but weaker than authored commit ancestry.
counterevidence_refs: The bundle and legacy database preserve reachable legacy content, and the quarantine retains the Fort/D-027/D-028/D-029 run evidence; no missing context was found that reverses a current exact-byte failure.
findings.first_introduced: Public reroot occurred 2026-07-19. The successor branch replayed W3/W5 on 2026-07-21 and left post-W5 D-033 through D-037 work outside commit ancestry.
findings.first_detectable: Immediately detectable from the current graph, identical ls-tree blobs, dirty status, legacy refs, and preserved run paths.
findings.why_earlier_checks_missed_it: Narrative documents cite hashes and runs, but current Git alone presents only the curated branch and cannot bisect uncommitted remediation stages.
findings.strongest_counterargument: The apparent repeated failures are reroot artifacts or consequences of missing legacy context.
findings.falsifier: Locate a preserved legacy blob or omitted run that changes a binding current formula, cap, or D-037 source finding. None was identified in the assigned evidence.
findings.attempted_break_test: Compared duplicated W3/W5 blob IDs across branches, inspected legacy refs/bundle, and checked current exact D-037 bytes without relying on commit messages.
reproduction: git ls-tree 19eca21 and 7a13197 for W3; d7ccd31 and cb76cd5 for spin traces; 75e1821 and 00a15d3 for W5.
unresolved: Exact first-introduction commits for dirty D-033 through D-037 bytes do not exist in the active Git graph.
Unreachable legacy objects were not exhaustively audited.
findings.recommendation: Before any future review, freeze the full candidate and authority files in one immutable snapshot manifest or commit while preserving the current dirty evidence unchanged.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not rewrite or delete the legacy/quarantine evidence, and do not use reroot uncertainty to dismiss current exact-byte failures.

findings.statement: Workflow sequencing and cost control repeatedly optimized the last observed failure without first closing the full executable-obligation graph. Fort r2/r3/r4/r5 each added net 293/384/210/299 run-local lines with blocker-movement ratios 0.25/0.25/0.50/0.25 and no endpoint. D-027 added 1,295 private-source lines at ratio 0.25; D-028's replacement was net +80 at 0.25; D-029 added 271 evidence lines at 0.25; the first W6/W7 review recorded a non-run net +1,060 at 0.25, while the current unexecuted W7 contract source alone is 2,198 lines. Legacy PORT-00-to-R-03C1A history also compressed 110 commits into about 25 hours, including 58 spec, 19 test, 12 feature, and 3 revert subjects. Line count is not itself a defect; repeated low-movement, last-defect packets are the recurrence amplifier.
assumptions_used: Run-local diffs are comparable as iteration-cost indicators but must not be summed as independent retained production LOC.
Commit-subject counts are process signals, not proof of technical waste.
counterevidence_refs: The hard stops prevented endpoint runs on incoherent designs, preserved raw failures, and often converted ambiguity into exact localized defects; fail-closed iteration had real evidence value.
findings.first_introduced: The pattern predates F-10 in the preserved 2026-07-12/13 Rust history and recurs in the 2026-07-17 through 2026-07-23 Fort and B3/W7 chains.
findings.first_detectable: Detectable whenever a remediation packet reported blocker movement 0.25 and immediately opened another packet for a newly exposed contract class; terminally clear by D-037.
findings.why_earlier_checks_missed_it: Cost verdicts assessed each local movement in isolation and did not impose a cross-revision closure matrix or stop-loss decision on accumulated design-only surface.
findings.strongest_counterargument: Historical churn is harmless because every later packet fixed the prior defect and prevented a worse implementation.
findings.falsifier: A next exact-byte review that closes the already enumerated obligations with no new failure class and materially raises blocker movement would support the benign-learning interpretation.
findings.attempted_break_test: Separated retained production LOC from overlapping run-local diffs and credited every genuine localization benefit before classifying the repeated low-movement sequence.
reproduction: Read the cost blocks in the preserved adjudications and count legacy subject prefixes over f52cdb2..0b2339c.
unresolved: Exact token use is UNAVAILABLE because the harness exposes no assignment-scoped counter.
No reliable all-surface cumulative LOC can be computed by summing overlapping run-local diffs.
findings.recommendation: Require an owner stop-or-continue decision before more edits. Any continuation should use one consolidated obligation ledger, a fixed review-cycle stop condition, and deletion/consolidation accounting before implementation.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not answer the accumulated design debt with one larger implementation-and-test push or report a segment/static improvement as endpoint progress.

findings.statement: The current SSOT surface is internally layered rather than singular: PROJECT_STATE's top overlay correctly records D-037 and requires a new owner decision, while its terminal Next action still says to stop at D-029 and omits D-030 through D-037. The authoritative gate registry is clearer: independent-FLRW, covariance-metrology, and current-tree full regression are FAIL; harness integrity is PASS only in the schema-v2 process boundary. This drift can mis-sequence work even though the latest decision log is correct.
assumptions_used: Readers may reasonably treat a section titled Next action as operative unless supersession is machine-explicit.
The gate registry and latest decision log outrank the stale terminal narrative.
counterevidence_refs: The newest overlay and decision log are explicit enough for a careful reviewer, and no evidence shows the stale section caused a forbidden execution.
findings.first_introduced: The terminal D-029 next-action text became stale as D-030 through D-037 overlays were added between 2026-07-22 and 2026-07-23.
findings.first_detectable: Detectable by comparing the first 160 and final 16 lines of current PROJECT_STATE with the current gate registry and decision log.
findings.why_earlier_checks_missed_it: Context generation includes both layers and validates hashes, not semantic supersession of prose next-action sections.
findings.strongest_counterargument: The top overlay obviously supersedes the historical lower section, so this is harmless documentation structure.
findings.falsifier: A deterministic SSOT resolver or consolidated single next-action section that rejects the stale D-029 instruction would remove the ambiguity.
findings.attempted_break_test: Compared current gate statuses and latest decisions against both PROJECT_STATE locations; no gate status was inferred from the stale narrative.
reproduction: sed -n 1,190p docs/harness/PROJECT_STATE.md; sed -n 1210,1276p docs/harness/PROJECT_STATE.md; inspect GATE_REGISTRY.json.
unresolved: No evidence establishes that this prose drift caused an actual unauthorized action.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate or explicitly mark the terminal D-029 section historical in the existing SSOT rather than adding another standalone gate.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not treat harness PASS, source-only checks, or the stale D-029 text as authority for remediation or execution.

seven_stage_record.self_discover: Mapped current refs/dirty surface, preserved legacy refs/bundle, Fort r2-r5 adjudications, D-027/D-028/D-029 artifacts, D-031-D-037 lifecycle evidence, current hooks, ledgers, gates, and the two allowed prior-run D-037 results. Initial hypotheses were multiple scientific failures, executable-contract debt, harness trust defects, and provenance/cost amplifiers.
seven_stage_record.step_back: Separated outcome failure from evidence-admission failure: method/source defects can fail science; harness/provenance defects can delay or invalidate trust; branch and SSOT drift can amplify recurrence. Partial algebraic passes and initial-only diagnostics are not endpoint evidence.
metacognitive_self_ask: Am I mistaking stricter later standards for defects knowable at the time? Checked prospective caps and contemporaneous proof obligations.
Am I blaming line count rather than semantics? Treated LOC only as cost/iteration evidence and credited localization gains.
Am I relying on commit messages? Preferred exact blobs, results, source, gates, and adjudications.
Could rerooting hide exculpatory evidence? Checked preserved refs/bundle/quarantine; exact first-introduction remains bounded where the tree is uncommitted.
Could harness failures explain science? Compared D-037 after schema-v2 repair; they do not.

steelman_debate.design_evolution_steelman: The staged programme repeatedly refused to hide RED results, preserved exact bytes, caught three candidate failures before trajectory, and used each Fort stage to convert uncertainty into a narrower defect. Partial nullspace, entropy, row-ii, normalization, cache, grid, and interpolation results are genuine. Some closure demands are expensive because reproducible independent transport is intrinsically hard.
design_concessions: Current D-035 bytes do not enforce their own shell, basis, tail, and trace contracts.
No W7, B3, or independent endpoint evidence exists.
steelman_debate.audit_steelman: Repeated FAILs reveal systemic executable-contract debt and a sequencing pattern in which the last named defect is patched without a complete obligation graph. Stopping before execution was cost-effective because it prevented invalid numerical evidence and a larger B3 implementation.
audit_concessions: D-027 through D-029 are distinct scientific failures, not one monolithic process defect.
Harness repair now works within its declared boundary.
Rerooting preserved substantial evidence and did not create the current source defects.
steelman_debate.discriminating_test: Before any owner-authorized edit, require a document-level clause-to-source/negative-control matrix for every binding W6/W7 obligation. An independent reviewer must be able to reject unequal-scale shell rescue, any node-value basis consumer, scalar-only signed tails, and incomplete traces using current bytes alone. Passing that test with no new obligation class would weaken the systemic-debt verdict.
